text:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] P0 - contextmap memory growth on hosted-runtime (multiple hosts approaching OOM) - paging oncall. Instance group: hosted-runtime-eu-west-2.
oncall-bot: Alert details: continuous-batcher + prefix caching causing contextmap entries to grow unbounded for long prompts. ETA: 2 min to memory pressure.
dmitri: got it, I'm oncall. Seeing sustained client requests with huge embedding+chat messages. Will collect top sessions.
melissa: customer-impact: 3 customers in eu-west experiencing 502s and token truncation. One churny prod tenant (tenant_id: t-78a9) has high LLM usage.
samir: logs show repeated prefix replication in prefetch step. snippet: ```ERROR runtime_kv: attempted_append: new_size=3.2GB limit=3.6GB session=abc123```
kevin: that session is using a ~250k token prompt (legal doc ingestion). Continuous-batcher is concatenating prefixes each request.
eng-runtime: quick question — can we throttle prefetch in-flight per session? We have a config flag `contextmap.max_session_entries` but it's not enforced for hosted defaults.
dmitri: I'm going to flip a soft limit on the evictor to force aggressive eviction for >1M tokens. Doing a hotpatch to increase eviction aggressiveness on the group.
melissa: please annotate which hosts are patched so SRE can watch. Also notify product-ops for customer comms.
eng-runtime: pushing hotpatch now: `kubectl -n hosted apply -f hotpatch-evictor.yaml` (increasing eviction_factor to 4x, lowering window cap).
ops-bot: deploy started: hotpatch-evictor.yaml -> hosted-runtime-eu-west-2, rollout 4/8 pods updated.
dmitri: patch applied to first 4 pods. Monitoring memory graphs.
kevin: enabling session-level cap: `contextmap.max_session_kv_bytes=2000000000` on the remaining pods as a safer fallback.
samir: I can add a temporary prefix filter to drop client metadata prefixes > 50k tokens. Will push filter to edge router.
melissa: customer-ops: drafting a short update: "We're mitigating an edge case where extremely long prompts can trigger excessive memory use. Temporary throttles deployed, no data lost, worked to restore service. More details to follow."
oncall-bot: Update: memory pressure dropping on patched pods, eviction events increasing, continuous-batcher backlog reduced.
dmitri: Confirming: evictor is trimming contextmap on heavy sessions, hosts no longer in OOM state. But two pods still showing GC spikes. I'll cordon one for deeper inspection.
eng-runtime: rolling a conservative config to all 8 pods now. `rollout status` shows 8/8 success.
kevin: as a longer-term fix we should: 1) enforce session kv caps by default, 2) add prefix-length histogram + alert, 3) adjust continuous-batcher batching heuristic to avoid concatenation loops.
melissa: agree. Also need a postmortem and customer timeline. Product-ops, can you create a customer bulletin for affected tenants?
product-ops: on it. Will include start/end times, root cause (unbounded contextmap growth due to long prompts + prefetch replication), mitigation steps, and planned fix ETA (2 weeks).
samir: logs attached for engineers: ```/var/log/hosted/runtime/contextmap-evictor.log: [2026-03-15T09:12:34Z] evict->session=abc123 removed 2.8GB```
dmitri: putting an action list here: - roll permanent default limits (eng-runtime) - add alert for session_kv_growth (sre) - provide customer timeline (product-ops) - run replay tests with 250k token prompts (ml-eng)
eng-runtime: I'll open a config PR with default caps + test plan.
melissa: any immediate customer impact left? product-ops?
product-ops: all affected customers restored to normal. One tenant saw truncated responses during 09:08-09:25 UTC. We'll send the bulletin after postmortem draft.
oncall-bot: Incident update: severity reduced to SEV-2; continue monitoring until 12:00 UTC.
dmitri: handing off to eng-runtime for follow-up and postmortem. I'm marking the pager as acknowledged resolved for immediate oncall.
eng-runtime: taking over. We'll do a root cause doc and schedule a retro. Thanks for fast responses.
ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-4921 - "Contextmap growth from long prompts - permanent caps and batch heuristic" and linked to this thread.
melissa: follow-ups: include customer remediation guidance (how to chunk documents), update hosted default configs, run synthetic load with long prompts.
kevin: one more: audit logs show 2k sessions had >10k token prefixes yesterday; we'll add a daily report.
product-ops: timeline for public bulletin: draft by EOD, finalize after postmortem.
dmitri: closing the active pager. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
